pageDescription: Record and manage your game clips with hardware-accelerated capture
renameExists: A clip with that name already exists
replayTimeDesc: Duration of the replay buffer in seconds
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this clip?
audioFallbackDesc: Could not capture the game's audio individually. All system audio is being recorded. Close unnecessary programs to avoid background noise.
appAudioDesc: Select which applications will have their audio captured
forceSoftwareTooltip: Uses CPU instead of GPU for video encoding. Useful if hardware encoding causes visual artifacts, crashes, or if the game is not detected properly.
deleteMultipleConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the selected clips?
saveClipDesc: Saves the clip from the replay buffer (last seconds)
toggleMicDesc: Toggles the microphone on or off during recording
pushToTalkDesc: Toggles the Push-to-Talk mode for the microphone
pushToTalkTooltip: Push-to-Talk: the microphone only captures audio while a chosen key is held (Hold mode) or toggles on/off each press (Toggle mode).
autoStartCaptureDesc: When a game is detected, automatically start recording
mergeHint: Add clips to merge (select multiple from the grid first)
needTwoClips: Need at least 2 clips to merge
noiseSuppressionTooltip: Reduces background noise from the microphone using built-in audio filters (anlmdn/arnndn). Helps eliminate keyboard, fan, or ambient noise.
adaptiveQualityTooltip: Automatically adjusts recording quality based on available RAM. Reduces CQ, resolution and buffer on low-memory systems to prevent stuttering. Disable for maximum quality at all times.
